ajustes.idioma.ayuda: For the app, the editor and the screen (date and labels of the included themes).
ajustes.sin_bandeja: Settings are only available when you open the editor from the Luzeira icon (next to the clock).
ajustes.auto.elegida: OK: Luzeira will find the screen by itself.
ajustes.importado: Theme imported. You'll find it in “My themes”.
ajustes.girar.ayuda: If your screen is mounted upside down.
ajustes.modelo.ayuda: Usually it's best to let Luzeira find it by itself. Choose here only if it doesn't, or if you have several.
ajustes.avanzado.aviso: Only if you know what's connected to each port: if it isn't a screen, it will get data it doesn't understand.
ajustes.avanzado.etiqueta: Port and model in advanced mode
ajustes.inicio.bloqueado: You removed Luzeira from startup in Windows, so it can only be turned back on there.
ajustes.inicio.windows.ayuda: Luzeira opens by itself when you turn on the PC, without asking for administrator rights.
ajustes.inicio.store: Luzeira is already in the Start menu, and it updates from the Store.
ajustes.actualizaciones.hay: You have {version}. There's a new version: {nueva}.
ajustes.actualizaciones.avisar.ayuda: Once a day it checks GitHub for a new version. It sends nothing about you and never installs until you press “Update”.
